name: singlet_enrichment_pathway_footprint_activity
title: Pathway activity from signed footprints
description: Scores each cell or pseudobulk sample for signaling pathway activity from signed, weighted footprint genes, with PROGENy as the default. Needs log-normalised expression whose gene symbols match the organism; writes a signed activity matrix and p-values only for methods that produce them. Use for per-sample or per-cell pathway activity. Do not use it to test condition differences (use singlet_enrichment_differential_pathway_activity) or for unsigned gene-set membership scores (use singlet_enrichment_per_cell_gene_set_scoring).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Normalised expression layer. Raw counts are rejected for linear methods.

organism.description: Must match the gene symbols; mouse uses the PROGENy mouse model.

method.description: Scoring method. Keep progeny unless a comparison is requested; p-values come only from ulm, mlm, viper and waggr.

top_n.description: Footprint genes per pathway, ranked by lowest PROGENy model p-value.

tmin.description: Minimum footprint genes present per pathway; smaller pathways are returned as missing.

scale.description: Z-score each pathway across samples; comparable only within one analysed set.

perm.description: 1 disables the permutation null; above 1 is the number of permutations.

pleiotropy.description: Apply the pleiotropy correction for regulators that share targets.

reg_sign.description: p-value threshold for significant regulators under pleiotropy.

n_targets.description: Minimum shared targets for a pleiotropy comparison.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for waggr and permutation runs.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/pathway_activity_progeny. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, organism, pathways (count scored), pathways_dropped (names below tmin), genes_per_pathway (mapping), options (resolved progeny or viper settings).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
